The '''Cultists''' are a pair of normal {{2|Monsters|Enemies}} found in the {{2|Underdocks}}. The encounter consists of a [[Calcified Cultist]] and a [[Damp Cultist]]. Both follow the same pattern: they buff on their first turn, then attack every turn after.

== Calcified Cultist ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Calcified Cultist
|Link   = Slay The Spire 2:Cultists#Calcified Cultist
|Image  = StS2_Calcified Cultist.png
|HP     = 38-41
|AscHP  = 39-42
|Debut  = Underdocks
|Type   = Normal
}}

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Calcified Cultist}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Incantation
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains 2 {{BD2|Ritual}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Ritual
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Dark Strike
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (9;{{Asc2|9|11}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always uses {{Int2|Calcified Cultist|Incantation}} first, then {{Int2|Calcified Cultist|Dark Strike}} every turn after.

=== Dialogue ===
When using {{Int2|Calcified Cultist|Incantation}}.
<blockquote><i>
{{TS||shake|OUR POWER IS UNMATCHED!}}
</i></blockquote>

{{Clear}}

== Damp Cultist ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = Damp Cultist
|Link   = Slay The Spire 2:Cultists#Damp Cultist
|Image  = StS2_Damp Cultist.png
|HP     = 51-53
|AscHP  = 52-54
|Debut  = Underdocks
|Type   = Normal
}}

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|Damp Cultist}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Incantation
|Intent = Buff
|Effect = Gains (5;{{Asc2|9|6}}) {{BD2|Ritual}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Ritual
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Dark Strike
|Intent = Attack1
|Effect = Deals (1;{{Asc2|9|3}}) damage.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Always uses {{Int2|Damp Cultist|Incantation}} first, then {{Int2|Damp Cultist|Dark Strike}} every turn after.

=== Dialogue ===
When using {{Int2|Damp Cultist|Incantation}}.
<blockquote><i>
{{TS||shake|CAW!<br>CAAAW}}
</i></blockquote>

{{Clear}}

== Notes ==
* The Cultists will not gain Strength on the turn that they use Incantation.
